title: Overdue invoice reminders
description: Remind the business's clients to pay their Stripe invoices that are past their due date

settings.DAYS_OVERDUE: days past the due date before the first reminder
settings.REMIND_EVERY_DAYS: days between reminders for the same invoice
settings.MAX_REMINDERS: how many reminders one invoice gets in all
settings.MIN_AMOUNT: invoices with less than this still due are skipped (in their currency)
